name: namewheel
description: Fair random picks with the NameWheel wheel in the chat: pick names, split random teams, run certified draws with a public proof page, and check any draw.

interface.longDescription:
Pick a name, a winner or an option at random, fairly, and watch the NameWheel wheel spin to the result right in the chat.

Split a class or a team into random groups, put the names on a wheel you can open on a projector, or let the wheel settle where to eat tonight.

When other people need to trust the result, run a certified draw: the winner is sealed before the spin and published on a permanent public proof page that anyone can recompute. You can also check any NameWheel draw from its code or link.

Certified draws, frozen entry lists and your draw history work once you connect your NameWheel account.
